info.name: Get list of transactions for a publisher

params.name: accessToken
params.description: User-level access token (also accepted as an Authorization Bearer header).

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start of range, format yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss. Max 31 days between start and end.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End of range, format yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss. Max 31 days between start and end.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone identifier, e.g. UTC, Europe/London, US/Eastern.

params.name: dateType
params.description: Which date to filter transactions on.

params.name: showBasketProducts
params.description: Include basket products when product-level tracking is enabled.

params.name: advertiserId
params.description: Single advertiser ID or comma-separated list.

items.docs: Pull individual transactions for a publisher over a date range of up to 31 days. Times use the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss format in the given timezone.
